name: Coordinator decide(research) → researcher-research-plan
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2. First rule of the research category pack. Fires when a coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=research) — the category classification token MVP-4 teaches the coordinator persona to emit. Spawns researcher-research-plan, the pack's plan-phase entry role. Replaces configs/rules/coordinator/01-delegate-research.json (whose decide(action=delegate_research) token spawns the legacy chain.mode-gated researcher-plan role); both rules co-exist during MVP-2 through MVP-6 build-up, the legacy delegate-research retires alongside chain.mode in MVP-7.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-plan
on_enter.prompt:
A coordinator classified the user's message as a research ask and delegated to you (parent loop $entity.instance).

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result with loop_id=$entity.instance. The result is the coordinator's structured decide-tool terminal (JSON with action + reason + subtopics + retry_hint). The coordinator's `reason` field captures the user's intent and the rationale for routing to the research category — that is your grounding for what to plan.

Iteration 2+ — emit a research plan per researcher-research-plan/10-plan-rules.md. The research category terminates at reviewer-research after synthesize emits the research artifact (no architect / spec / build phases). Keep the plan focused on evidence gathering and synthesis.

Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase, decide(action="emit") only if the question is genuinely answerable from the plan itself without gather work, or decide(action="needs_clarification") if the coordinator's reason is too thin to plan from.
